$comment: drain.staleGateUpdateBranchMax: maximum stale-failed merge-gate branch updates per pass (standard 2; 0 disables; integer 0..100). Resolves standard -> platform drain -> tool drain -> WE_DRAIN_STALE_GATE_UPDATE_BRANCH_MAX, logging effective value and source. Only an absent key defaults; null, objects and invalid values disable repair. Only BLOCKED, mergeable, non-fork PRs on the default branch with ready-to-merge, review:accepted, red-team:clear, no review hold or live fix claim, newest current-head merge-gate failure and APPROVED reviewDecision (or explicit null/empty when no review is required), and every other live required check green from its required app id qualify. Unknown app identity or a missing reviewDecision skips. Each head is attempted once, including API failures. Unknown/incomplete evidence skips; operators inspect and update the branch manually. Coordination state is under stale-gate-update-branch/.
